story_seed.theme: learning about Stephen Hawking's life, discoveries, and perseverance
story_seed.setting: Sydney Science Museum with special Stephen Hawking exhibition, library, and home
learning_objectives: Stephen Hawking was a brilliant scientist who studied black holes and the universe
He had a condition called ALS but never gave up on his dreams
Science is about asking questions and being curious about how things work
Anyone can be a scientist, no matter what challenges they face
The universe is full of amazing mysteries waiting to be discovered
Perseverance and determination help us overcome obstacles
